spans.s: उरच् tad-affix उर, with udātta accent on the last vowel, affixed to the word दन्त when it refers to protu- berant teeth; cf.

उरःप्रभृति a class of words headed by the word उरस् to which the samā- sānta affix क (कप् ) is added, when these words stand at the end of Bahuvrihi compounds; cf. व्यूढमुरोस्य व्यूढोरस्कः similarly प्रियसर्पिष्कः, Kāś. on P.V.
उरस्य produced at the breast; cf.केचि- देता उरस्या R.Pr.
, explained by the commentator as केचिदाचार्याः एतौ हकारविसर्जनीयौ उरःस्थाने इच्छन्ति ।
